_readme: A BATCH IS DATA. No code lives in this file and none may. The grids below are laid out exactly like the photograph: three rows of three, reading left to right. Where a print sits in the array IS where it sits on the sheet, so there are no position numbers to get wrong. Full instructions: brain-config/hooks/batch-import.md
label: Sheet 4 · Ice Cream
source: Two photographs, 2026-07-31. 🔴 CORRECTED 2026-07-31 ~17:00 - BOTH GRIDS WERE TRANSCRIBED 90 DEGREES OFF. The sheet was photographed on its side (the punch strip ran HORIZONTALLY across the frame, which is structurally impossible for an upright 9-pocket page), and the grid was read row-wise anyway. Re-shot upright and both faces rotated 90 CW to match. The error was a single rigid rotation, identical on both faces - not a scramble. Front/back was CORRECT and is now confirmed rather than assumed: the truck face is the front.

mr-softee.notes: A blue and white Mr. Softee ice cream truck, lettered SHAKES SUNDAES CONES. The image is LANDSCAPE, so Ana wrote the title vertically up the card's left edge instead of along the lower margin like every other card on this face. ⚠️ This card is what caused the 90-degree transcription error: in the sideways original photo it was the ONE caption that read horizontally, and it got treated as the upright sample while the other eight were written off as quirks. Caption orientation is a MAJORITY VOTE, never a single sample. Signed AI.
